scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n api,ui,app "npm run backend" "npm run dev" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health http-get://localhost:5173 && npm run electron"
scripts.backend: cd .. && if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then echo 'backend already running on :8000'; tail -f /dev/null; else exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --reload --port 8000; fi
